card.line: Macedonia was a Roman province north of Greece, and the first part of Europe to hear the gospel from Paul after he was called there.

moments.title: The Call to Macedonia
moments.text: During the night, Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia pleading, "Come over to Macedonia and help us." As soon as he saw it, they got ready to leave, concluding that God had called them to preach the gospel there.

moments.title: Arriving at Philippi
moments.text: Paul and his companions went to Philippi, the leading city of that district of Macedonia, and stayed several days. On the Sabbath they spoke to women gathered by the river, and the Lord opened Lydia's heart to respond to Paul's message. She and her household were baptized.

moments.title: Generous Churches of Macedonia
moments.text: Paul told the Corinthians about the grace God gave the churches of Macedonia. Though they suffered and were very poor, they were full of joy and gave freely, even beyond what they were able to give.
